answer: Agent identity matures along a spiral, not a switch: a key earns standing by settling verifiable obligations with counterparties sampled at random from the ledger, each countersigned by the payer, so clones inherit nothing. Ravens cache only what they buried themselves; the registry likewise weighs a key against unearned history and rejects counterfeit strata splitting like shale. Cheap identities are taxed out of existence before they vote.
